notes:
CIRCUIT: a 10 V source (V-DC #7) feeds a 20 ohm series resistor (#2) into a two-branch parallel block, then the block's far side ties to a 10 A current source (I-DC #6) and a 10 ohm shunt resistor (#5), all returning on a bottom rail that carries the GND symbol (#8). The parallel block is drawn as a rectangle between the vertical at x~345 (left, S7) and the vertical at x~655 (right, S6): the TOP branch is 20 mH (#1) in series with 2 ohm (#0); the BOTTOM branch is 2 uF (#4) in series with 10 mH (#3).

NET MAP (6 nets, 9 components):
  0  = bottom return rail at y~625, from the V-DC bottom terminal at x~194 across to the 10 ohm resistor's bottom at x~867: V-DC #7 t1, I-DC #6 t1 (down the x~725 column), R10 #5 t1, GND #8.
  n4 = V-DC #7 top terminal up to y~430 and right to the left lead of the 20 ohm resistor #2.
  n3 = LEFT node of the parallel block (the x~345 vertical, S7): right lead of R20 #2, left lead of L20mH #1 (top branch), left plate of C2uF #4 (bottom branch).
  n1 = mid-node of the top branch: right lead of L20mH #1 to the left lead of R2 #0 (single wire edge e7, (474,371)->(502,374), verified with edges.py).
  n5 = mid-node of the bottom branch: right plate of C2uF #4 to the left lead of L10mH #3.
  n2 = RIGHT node of the parallel block (the x~655 vertical, S6) continuing right along y~427: right lead of R2 #0, right lead of L10mH #3, top terminal of I-DC #6 (via the x~735 stub, S9), top terminal of R10 #5.

JUDGEMENT CALLS / SITES:
  S6 (654,427) CRITICAL -> JUNCTION. The crop shows a clean T: the vertical right edge of the parallel-block rectangle runs from y~375 down to y~500, and the horizontal wire heading right toward the current source terminates on it at y=427. Nothing continues left of x=654 at that height, so this cannot be a crossing. Reading it any other way would isolate the whole parallel block from the current source and the 10 ohm load.
  S7 (345,428) CRITICAL -> JUNCTION. Mirror image of S6: the left vertical edge of the rectangle spans y~375..500 and the 20 ohm resistor's right lead terminates on it at y=428. A T, hence a junction. The other reading would leave the source/20-ohm branch dangling.
  S9 (734,426) -> JUNCTION (became CRITICAL only after the #6 port fix below re-pointed the current source's top terminal onto this stub). The crop shows an unambiguous T: the y~427 rail runs continuously left-right and the current source's top lead rises from the circle and terminates on it; nothing continues above the rail at x=734. Junction. The other reading would strand the current source's top terminal.
  S27 (731,624) CRITICAL -> JUNCTION (OVERRIDES the tracer, which defaulted to 'crossing' on hop=7.7, dot=2.0). inkmap.py at (731,624) shows the current source's return column arriving at cols 724-727 and ending at y~620, the ground column leaving at cols 730-734 from y~617 downward, and the horizontal bottom rail occupying y=621-624 on the left (ending at col 733) and y=625-630 on the right (starting at col 731). So the 'hop' the tracer scored is only a ~5 px lateral pen step where the drafter restarted the stroke at the rail - there is no semicircular arc and no clean sideways detour around a wire; the rail itself is likewise drawn in two strokes with a few px of vertical offset at the same spot, which is what pushed the metric up. Decided junction on rule 1 (electrical impossibility): under the crossing reading the bottom rail would split into {V-DC bottom, R10 bottom} and {I-DC bottom, GND}, which leaves the 10 A current source driving into a two-terminal dead end (no return path for its current) and leaves the GND reference touching nothing but that source. With the junction reading the circuit is the textbook one - V-DC + R20 feeding the LC parallel block, with the current source and the 10 ohm resistor both shunted to the grounded return rail.
  Non-critical sites all sit on handwritten text or symbol ink and were left at the tracer default: S0/S1 are the 'H' of '20mH' brushing the 2 ohm resistor box; S4 is the '2' of '20 ohm'; S13 is the '1' of '10 ohm'; S14/S16/S17/S19/S20 are '10mH'; S21/S22/S24 are '2MF'; S25/S26 are the 'A' of '10A' touching the source circle.

The real top lead is p1@(735,455) with a 27 px wire running up to the y~427 rail.
